## [Data observasi]{style="color:#db84c5;"}

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forecast)
library(knitr)
library(rmarkdown)

# Membaca data
data <- read_excel("~/Downloads/Informasi Kurs Jisdor.xlsx", skip = 4)

# Cek nama kolom
names(data)

# Mengambil data observasi 196-390
data_aku <- data %>%
  filter(NO >= 196 & NO <= 390) %>%
  select(NO, Tanggal, Kurs)

# Mengubah tanggal menjadi format Date
data_aku$Tanggal <- as.Date(
  data_aku$Tanggal,
  format = "%d/%m/%Y"
)

# Melihat data
head(data_aku)
tail(data_aku)

# Jumlah observasi
nrow(data_aku)
```

## [Eksplorasi Data]{style="color:#db84c5;"}

```{r}
# Eksplorasi Data
summary(data_aku$Kurs)

mean(data_aku$Kurs)
sd(data_aku$Kurs)
min(data_aku$Kurs)
max(data_aku$Kurs)
```

```{r}
# Grafik Time Series
ggplot(data_aku, aes(x = Tanggal, y = Kurs)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Pergerakan Kurs Jisdor IDR/USD",
    subtitle = "Observasi 196–390",
    x = "Tanggal",
    y = "Kurs (IDR/USD)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## [SMA]{style="color:#db84c5;"}

```{r}
library(TTR)
# SMA orde 3

data_aku$SMA <- NA

for (i in 4:nrow(data_aku)) {
  data_aku$SMA[i] <- mean(
    data_aku$Kurs[(i-3):(i-1)]
  )
}

head(data_aku[, c("Tanggal", "Kurs", "SMA")])

# Forecast error
data_aku$error_SMA <- data_aku$Kurs - data_aku$SMA

# Absolute error
data_aku$abs_error_SMA <- abs(data_aku$error_SMA)

# Squared error
data_aku$sq_error_SMA <- data_aku$error_SMA^2

# APE
data_aku$APE_SMA <- abs(data_aku$error_SMA / data_aku$Kurs) * 100

MAE_SMA <- mean(data_aku$abs_error_SMA, na.rm = TRUE)

SSE_SMA <- sum(data_aku$sq_error_SMA, na.rm = TRUE)

MSE_SMA <- mean(data_aku$sq_error_SMA, na.rm = TRUE)

RMSE_SMA <- sqrt(MSE_SMA)

MAPE_SMA <- mean(data_aku$APE_SMA, na.rm = TRUE)

MAE_SMA
SSE_SMA
MSE_SMA
RMSE_SMA
MAPE_SMA
```

## [DMA]{style="color:#db84c5;"}

```{r}
# DMA
S1 <- SMA(data_aku$Kurs, n = 3)

S2 <- SMA(S1, n = 3)

data_aku$S1 <- S1
data_aku$S2 <- S2

# Nilai level
data_aku$a_DMA <- 2 * data_aku$S1 - data_aku$S2

# Nilai trend
data_aku$b_DMA <- (2 / (3 - 1)) *
  (data_aku$S1 - data_aku$S2)

# Forecast satu periode ke depan
data_aku$DMA <- lag(data_aku$a_DMA, 1) +
  lag(data_aku$b_DMA, 1)

data_aku$error_DMA <- data_aku$Kurs - data_aku$DMA

data_aku$abs_error_DMA <- abs(data_aku$error_DMA)

data_aku$sq_error_DMA <- data_aku$error_DMA^2

data_aku$APE_DMA <-
  abs(data_aku$error_DMA / data_aku$Kurs) * 100

MAE_DMA <- mean(data_aku$abs_error_DMA, na.rm = TRUE)

SSE_DMA <- sum(data_aku$sq_error_DMA, na.rm = TRUE)

MSE_DMA <- mean(data_aku$sq_error_DMA, na.rm = TRUE)

RMSE_DMA <- sqrt(MSE_DMA)

MAPE_DMA <- mean(data_aku$APE_DMA, na.rm = TRUE)

MAE_DMA
SSE_DMA
MSE_DMA
RMSE_DMA
MAPE_DMA
```

## [SES]{style="color:#db84c5;"}

```{r}
# SES
alpha <- seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01)

hasil_SES <- data.frame(
  alpha = alpha,
  RMSE = NA
)

for (i in 1:length(alpha)) {
  
  model <- ses(
    data_aku$Kurs,
    alpha = alpha[i],
    initial = "simple"
  )
  
  error <- data_aku$Kurs - fitted(model)
  
  hasil_SES$RMSE[i] <-
    sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Alpha terbaik
hasil_SES[which.min(hasil_SES$RMSE), ]

alpha_terbaik <- hasil_SES$alpha[
  which.min(hasil_SES$RMSE)
]

alpha_terbaik

#Model
model_SES <- ses(
  data_aku$Kurs,
  alpha = alpha_terbaik,
  h = 1
)

data_aku$SES <- fitted(model_SES)

# Error
data_aku$error_SES <-
  data_aku$Kurs - data_aku$SES

data_aku$abs_error_SES <-
  abs(data_aku$error_SES)

data_aku$sq_error_SES <-
  data_aku$error_SES^2

data_aku$APE_SES <-
  abs(data_aku$error_SES / data_aku$Kurs) * 100

```

```{r}
#Evaluasi
MAE_SES <- mean(data_aku$abs_error_SES, na.rm = TRUE)

SSE_SES <- sum(data_aku$sq_error_SES, na.rm = TRUE)

MSE_SES <- mean(data_aku$sq_error_SES, na.rm = TRUE)

RMSE_SES <- sqrt(MSE_SES)

MAPE_SES <- mean(data_aku$APE_SES, na.rm = TRUE)

MAE_SES
SSE_SES
MSE_SES
RMSE_SES
MAPE_SES
```

## [DES]{style="color:#db84c5;"}

```{r}
#DES
# Double Exponential Smoothing (DES)
model_DES <- holt(
  data_aku$Kurs,
  h = 1,
  damped = FALSE
)

model_DES

```

```{r}
alpha_DES <- model_DES$model$par["alpha"]
beta_DES <- model_DES$model$par["beta"]

alpha_DES
beta_DES
```

```{r}
data_aku$DES <- as.numeric(fitted(model_DES))
head(data_aku[, c("Tanggal", "Kurs", "DES")])
```

```{r}
data_aku$error_DES <- data_aku$Kurs - data_aku$DES

data_aku$abs_error_DES <- abs(data_aku$error_DES)

data_aku$sq_error_DES <- data_aku$error_DES^2

data_aku$APE_DES <- 
  abs(data_aku$error_DES / data_aku$Kurs) * 100
```

```{r}
MAE_DES <- mean(
  data_aku$abs_error_DES,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

SSE_DES <- sum(
  data_aku$sq_error_DES,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

MSE_DES <- mean(
  data_aku$sq_error_DES,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

RMSE_DES <- sqrt(MSE_DES)

MAPE_DES <- mean(

)

MAE_DES
SSE_DES
MSE_DES
RMSE_DES
MAPE_DES
```

## [Forecast periode berikutnya]{style="color:#db84c5;"}

```{r}
forecast_SMA <- tail(
  SMA(data_aku$Kurs, n = 3),
  1
)

forecast_DMA <- tail(
  data_aku$a_DMA + data_aku$b_DMA,
  1
)

forecast_SES <- forecast(
  model_SES,
  h = 1
)$mean

forecast_DES <- forecast(
  model_DES,
  h = 1
)$mean

forecast_akhir <- data.frame(
  Metode = c("SMA", "DMA", "SES", "DES"),
  Forecast = c(
    forecast_SMA,
    forecast_DMA,
    forecast_SES,
    forecast_DES
  )
)

forecast_akhir
```
